summary: Line runs through thick bush off Union Street; no road, no way in.
reasons: No Stopping signs at the mouth

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 13 m from the line at 4 m and 16 m, townhouses to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Line crosses dense tree cover with no tracks or vehicles; only the first metres meet the sealed road, which has No Stopping signs.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street at the east end.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the start
sun_shade: Heavy canopy over most of the line.
